We have two open roles in Cybersecurity R&D at Comcast NBC. If you have a background in cybersecurity or AI, please apply even if you think that all job requirements don’t apply to your research.

1. Security Researcher:

Both of these roles at based out of HQ at Philadelphia, PA and do not have sponsorship (you will need to be a US citizen, resident, or hold an independent immigration status, e.g. previous H1B).

Please also feel free to reach out to me with any questions or to learn more about these roles!
